heading.zh-Hant: 出身、戰地任官與皇家飛行軍團
heading.en: Origins, field commission and the Royal Flying Corps

body.zh-Hant: 據 Air of Authority（rafweb）頁面，凱斯·帕克生於1892年6月15日，出生於紐西蘭。他因在加里波利的卓越服務獲得戰地任官，後來在索姆河身負重傷，退出砲兵兩個月後加入皇家飛行軍團，並自1918年4月10日起任第48中隊指揮官。
body.en: According to the Air of Authority (rafweb) page, Keith Park was born on 15 June 1892 in New Zealand. He was awarded a field commission for distinguished service at Gallipoli, was seriously wounded on the Somme, and joined the RFC two months after being invalided out of the Artillery; from 10 April 1918 he commanded No 48 Squadron.

citations.quote: he was born in New Zealand
He was awarded a field commission for distinguished service at Gallipoli.
Seriously wounded on the Somme
he was invalided out of the Artillery but two months later joined the RFC.
10 Apr 1918: Officer Commanding, No 48 Sqn.

heading.zh-Hant: 戰鬥機司令部、敦克爾克與不列顛戰役
heading.en: Fighter Command, Dunkirk and the Battle of Britain

body.zh-Hant: 1938年6月11日，帕克出任戰鬥機司令部總部高級空軍參謀官；1940年4月他受命指揮倫敦周邊的第11戰鬥機大隊。敦克爾克撤退期間他可調用十六個颶風與噴火式中隊，並親自駕颶風機飛越敦克爾克數次。不列顛戰役中，他的指令主張集中攻擊轟炸機，與第12大隊的「大機群」之爭由此而來；他於12月18日由利－馬洛里接替。
body.en: On 11 June 1938 Park became Senior Air Staff Officer at HQ Fighter Command, and in April 1940 he was given command of No. 11 Fighter Group around London. During the Dunkirk evacuation he had sixteen Hurricane and Spitfire squadrons and personally flew his Hurricane over Dunkirk several times. In the Battle of Britain his instructions favoured concentrating on enemy bombers, which fed the "Big Wing" controversy with No. 12 Group; Leigh-Mallory replaced him on 18 December.

citations.quote: 11 Jun 1938: Senior Air Staff Officer, HQ Fighter Command
In April 1940 Park was given command of No.11 Fighter Group
Park had sixteen Hurricane and Spitfire squadrons available to him
Park himself flew his own Hurricane over Dunkirk on several occasions.
Park believed his squadrons should concentrate on destroying enemy bombers
This led to the 'Big Wing' controversy
he was replaced by Leigh-Mallory on 18 December

heading.zh-Hant: 第23訓練大隊、埃及與馬爾他接任
heading.en: No. 23 Group, Egypt and the move to Malta

body.zh-Hant: 帕克1940年12月27日轉任第23訓練大隊指揮官。後來他出任埃及空軍司令部指揮官：rafweb 記為1942年1月，歷史網站則寫1941年秋，兩者不一。1942年7月15日他改任馬爾他空軍司令，接替洛伊德；他一到任便改變戰鬥機戰術，令戰機起飛後向北爬升迎擊來襲敵機。
body.en: Park became AOC No. 23 (Training) Group on 27 December 1940. He then took the Egypt air command, which rafweb dates to January 1942 while the History of War page says autumn 1941. On 15 July 1942 he became AOC Malta, replacing AVM H P Lloyd, and soon changed fighter tactics so that fighters headed north after take-off and climbed to meet the raiders.

citations.quote: 27 Dec 1940: AOC, No 23 (Training)
xx Jan 1942: AOC, AHQ Egypt
In the autumn of 1941 he received an overseas command
becoming Air officer Commanded in Egypt
15 Jul 1942: AOC, AHQ Malta
so he was appointed AOC in place of AVM H P Lloyd
he ordered his fighters to head north after taking off

heading.zh-Hant: 佩德斯托行動與馬爾他攻勢
heading.en: Operation Pedestal and the Malta offensive

body.zh-Hant: 1942年8月，帕克參與護衛「基座行動」船團：他的噴火式與美男子式戰機掩護船團，十四艘商船中僅五艘抵達馬爾他。埃爾阿拉曼之後，他的部隊轉入攻勢，參與突尼西亞戰事與西西里入侵，馬爾他、戈佐與潘泰萊里亞並建有四十個戰鬥機中隊。1944年1月14日，他升任地中海與中東皇家空軍總司令。
body.en: In August 1942 Park took part in the defence of Operation Pedestal; his Spitfires and Beaufighters covered the convoy, and only five of its fourteen merchant ships reached Malta. After El Alamein his forces went onto the offensive, fighting in Tunisia and in the invasion of Sicily, with forty fighter squadrons based on Malta, Gozo and Pantelleria. On 14 January 1944 he became Commander-in-Chief of the RAF in the Mediterranean and Middle East.

citations.quote: In August Park played a part in the defence of Operation Pedestal
his Spitfires and Beaufighters provided fighter cover around the convoy
Although only five of the fourteen merchant ships in the convoy reached Malta
taking part in the fighting in Tunisia and the invasion of Sicily
forty squadrons of fighters alone based on Malta, Gozo and Pantelleria
On 14 January 1944 Park was promoted to become Commander-in-Chief of the RAF

heading.zh-Hant: 東南亞空軍總司令與退役
heading.en: Air Command South East Asia and retirement

body.zh-Hant: 1944年11月，利－馬洛里在赴任東南亞空軍總司令途中死於空難，帕克被選為接替人選。rafweb 記他自1945年2月25日起任東南亞盟軍空軍總司令；新職責是每日為緬甸前進的部隊空運最多2000噸物資，並提供攻擊性的戰鬥轟炸機掩護。名冊記1946年4月30日皮里接任該職；帕克於1946年退役，軍階為空軍上將。
body.en: In November 1944 Leigh-Mallory was killed on his way to Air Command South East Asia and Park was chosen to replace him. Rafweb records him as Allied Air C in C, Air Command South East Asia from 25 February 1945; his task was to fly up to 2,000 tons of supplies a day to the advancing armies in Burma and to give aggressive fighter-bomber cover. The rafweb lists show George Pirie taking over the post on 30 April 1946; Park retired in 1946 as an Air Chief Marshal.

Leigh-Mallory, was tragically killed
the person chosen to replace him was Keith Park.

heading.zh-Hant: 出身與早年軍旅
heading.en: Origins and early service

body.zh-Hant: 據 Air of Authority（rafweb）頁面，羅德里克·卡爾生於1891年8月31日。他就讀於紐西蘭威靈頓學院，先加入紐西蘭遠征軍，再轉入皇家海軍航空隊；1918年6月22日起任第91中隊指揮官。
body.en: According to the Air of Authority (rafweb) page, Roderick Carr was born on 31 August 1891. He was educated at Wellington College in New Zealand and joined the New Zealand Expeditionary Force before transferring to the RNAS; from 22 June 1918 he commanded No 91 Squadron.

citations.quote: He was educated at Wellington College in New Zealand
joined the New Zealand Expeditionary Force before transferring to the RNAS
22 Jun 1918: Officer Commanding, No 91 Sqn.

heading.zh-Hant: 北俄羅斯遠征與長程飛行紀錄
heading.en: North Russia and the 1927 distance record

body.zh-Hant: 1919年3月17日，卡爾出任北俄羅斯遠征軍中斯拉夫－英國航空軍團第2中隊指揮官。據 DFC 嘉獎令，他駕偵察機低空飛越敵方普切加機場，擊燃一架尼厄波特敵機與一座機庫。1927年5月20至23日，他與吉爾曼駕霍克霍斯利機自克蘭威爾不著陸飛抵波斯灣，創下3420英里新紀錄。
body.en: On 17 March 1919 Carr became Officer Commanding No 2 Sqn, Slavo-British Aviation Corps, in the North Russian Expedition. According to his DFC citation he flew a scout machine over the enemy aerodrome at Puchega, setting fire to a Nieuport and a hangar. Between 20 and 23 May 1927 he and Gillman flew a Hawker Horsley non-stop from Cranwell to the Persian Gulf, a new distance record of 3420 miles.

North Russian Expedition.
flew a scout machine over the enemy aerodrome at Puchega
setting fire to a Nieuport enemy machine, to a hangar
they set a new non-stop distance record of 3420 miles
flying a Hawker Horsley from Cranwell to the Persian Gulf
between 20 and 23 May 1927

heading.zh-Hant: 第二次世界大戰中的大隊指揮
heading.en: Group commands in the Second World War

body.zh-Hant: 二戰期間，卡爾1940年7月1日起指揮第61大隊，8月1日轉任北愛爾蘭皇家空軍司令，1941年7月26日接掌轟炸機司令部第4大隊，任職至1945年6月前後。1945年6月他轉任盟軍遠征軍最高總部副參謀長（空軍）。
body.en: In the Second World War Carr commanded No 61 Group from 1 July 1940, became AOC HQ RAF in Northern Ireland on 1 August 1940, and took over No 4 Group on 26 July 1941, a post he held until about June 1945, when he became Deputy Chief of Staff (Air) at Supreme HQ Allied Expeditionary Force.

heading.zh-Hant: 東南亞、印度與退役
heading.en: South East Asia, India and later posts

body.zh-Hant: 1945年8月22日，卡爾任東南亞基地空軍司令；1946年4月1日出任印度空軍總部總司令（AOC in C）。1947年1月7日起，他改任民航部倫敦及東南部分區主管。
body.en: On 22 August 1945 Carr became Air Marshal Commanding, HQ Base Air Forces South East Asia; on 1 April 1946 he became AOC in C, AHQ India. From 7 January 1947 he served as Divisional Controller, London & South East Division, Ministry of Civil Aviation.

heading.zh-Hant: 北俄羅斯遠征戰役與長程飛行
heading.en: North Russia campaign and the long-distance flight

body.zh-Hant: 1919年3月17日，卡爾出任斯拉夫－英國航空軍團第2中隊指揮官，參與北俄羅斯遠征戰役。據記載，他駕偵察機飛越敵方普切加機場上空，擊燃一架尼厄波特敵機與一座機庫，此作戰事蹟獲頒傑出飛行十字勳章。1927年5月20至23日，他駕霍克霍斯利機自克蘭威爾不著陸飛往波斯灣，創下3420英里的長程紀錄。
body.en: On 17 March 1919 Carr became Officer Commanding No 2 Squadron, Slavo-British Aviation Corps, in the North Russian Expedition campaign. He flew a scout machine over the enemy aerodrome at Puchega, setting fire to a Nieuport and a hangar, an action for which he received the DFC. Between 20 and 23 May 1927 he flew a Hawker Horsley from Cranwell to the Persian Gulf, a non-stop record of 3420 miles.

heading.zh-Hant: 出身與早期戰爭
heading.en: Origins and early wars

body.zh-Hant: 據 Greek City Times 的文章，亞歷山大·帕普哥斯生於1883年12月9日，生於雅典，家族根源在小亞細亞的艾瓦利。自1906年起他在希臘軍中服役45年，參加過巴爾幹戰爭（1912至1913年）與小亞細亞戰役（1919至1922年）。
body.en: Per a Greek City Times article, Alexandros Papagos was born on 9 December 1883 in Athens, with roots in Aivali, Asia Minor. From 1906 he served 45 years in the Greek military, taking part in the Balkan Wars (1912-13) and the Asia Minor Campaign (1919-22).

citations.quote: Alexandros Papagos (December 9, 1883 – October 4, 1955)
Born in Athens but with roots in Aivali, Asia Minor
Starting from 1906, Papagos served 45 years in the Greek Military
serving in the Balkan Wars (1912-13), the Asia Minor Campaign (1919-22)

heading.zh-Hant: 陸軍部長與陸軍總參謀長
heading.en: War minister and Army General Staff chief

body.zh-Hant: 據 protothema 與 Orthodoxia 的文章，帕普哥斯曾任軍事（陸軍）部長，列於孔迪利斯內閣（1935年10月10日至11月30日）與代梅爾齊斯內閣（1935年12月19日至1936年3月5日）。1936年8月1日他接任陸軍總參謀部（ΓΕΣ）參謀長，並與梅塔克薩斯從頭整編陸軍、擬定完整的動員計畫。
body.en: According to protothema and Orthodoxia articles, Papagos was Minister for Military Affairs in the Kondylis government (10 October–30 November 1935) and the Demertzis government (19 December 1935–5 March 1936). On 1 August 1936 he took over as chief of the Army General Staff (GES) and, with Metaxas, rebuilt the army from the ground up and prepared a complete mobilisation plan.

citations.quote: Υπουργός Στρατιωτικών στις Κυβερνήσεις Γ. Κονδύλη (10/10-30/11/1935)
Την 1η Αυγούστου 1936 ο Παπάγος ανέλαβε την αρχηγία του ΓΕΣ
διοργάνωσαν και συγκρότησαν εκ βάθρων τον Ελληνικό Στρατό
οργάνωσαν ένα άρτιο σχέδιο επιστρατεύσεως

heading.zh-Hant: 希意戰爭與1941年希臘戰役
heading.en: The Greco-Italian War and the Battle of Greece

body.zh-Hant: 希意戰爭爆發的1940年10月28日，帕普哥斯已是總司令；他指揮阿爾巴尼亞戰線的希臘軍事行動，希軍在他的指揮下遏止義軍攻勢並把對方逼回阿爾巴尼亞北部。1941年德軍南下時，英國官方戰史稱他為盟軍總司令：4月9日他中止阿爾巴尼亞戰線上對義軍的攻勢，10日下令英軍W部隊撤退，16日同意撤至色摩比利防線，並向英方提議全數撤出希臘；據 protothema，他於4月23日請辭，不願參與投降程序。
body.en: On 28 October 1940, when the Greco-Italian War began, Papagos was already Commander-in-Chief; he directed Greek operations on the Albanian front, and under his command the Greek army halted the Italian advance and pushed it back into northern Albania. In the 1941 German campaign the British official history calls him Allied Commander-in-Chief: he broke off the attack on the Italians on 9 April, ordered W Force to withdraw on 10 April, approved the retirement to Thermopylae on 16 April and suggested the British withdraw from Greece altogether; according to protothema he resigned on 23 April rather than take part in the capitulation.

citations.quote: Papagos directed Greek operations against the Italians on the Albanian front
halted the Italian advance and pushed them back into northern Albania
From the point of view of the Allied Commander-in-Chief, General Papagos
Until only the day before, 9th April
the Greeks had been attacking the Italians on part of the Albanian front
On 10th April General Papagos ordered the withdrawal of W Force
General Papagos then approved the retirement to Thermopylae
consider withdrawing their forces from Greece altogether

heading.zh-Hant: 佔領、內戰與政壇
heading.en: Occupation, civil war and politics

body.zh-Hant: 希臘遭德軍佔領後，帕普哥斯組織由希臘軍官組成的抵抗團體；1943年他被德軍逮捕並押往達豪集中營，直到1945年解放。1949年1月10日他接受總司令職務，領導對共產黨游擊隊的最後勝利；1951年5月30日他提出辭呈，其後創立希臘聯盟黨，1952年11月選舉獲勝，擔任首相直至1955年10月4日去世。
body.en: After the German occupation Papagos organised a resistance movement of Greek officers; in 1943 he was arrested by the Germans and sent to Dachau, where he remained until liberation in 1945. He accepted the post of Commander-in-Chief on 10 January 1949 to lead the final victory over the communist guerrillas; on 30 May 1951 he submitted his resignation, then founded the Greek Rally, won the November 1952 elections, and served as Prime Minister until his death on 4 October 1955.

heading.zh-Hant: 海軍領導層與軍官團整肅
heading.en: Naval leadership and the officer-corps purges

body.zh-Hant: 據約阿尼納大學機構典藏中馬拉卡塞斯的論文，薩凱拉里歐與卡瓦迪亞斯兩位海軍上將對海軍軍官團的整肅，嚴重動搖希臘艦隊的戰鬥力；論文稱他為「復仇主義者」（revanchist）的希臘海軍總司令。
body.en: According to J. T. Malakasses's paper in the University of Ioannina repository, the purges of the naval officer corps by admirals Kavvadias and Sakellariou put the fighting capability of the Greek Fleet seriously at stake; the paper calls Sakellariou the "revanchist" commander-in-chief of the Greek Navy.

citations.quote: admirals Kaw adias and Sakellariou put seriously at stake the fighting
citations.evidenceNote: 原文拼寫「Kaw adias」為原文如此

citations.quote: of the C.-in-C. of the Greek Navy the revanchist admiral Sakellariou

heading.zh-Hant: 「兩人指導部」
heading.en: The "directorate of the Two"

body.zh-Hant: 同篇論文指出，直到1943年為止，希臘海軍由薩凱拉里歐與卡瓦迪亞斯兩位上將的「指導部」所塑造；另兩位上將歐伊科諾穆與德拉格拉馬提卡斯與他們一起組成海軍最高委員會。
body.en: The same paper says that up to 1943 the Greek Navy was molded by the "directorate" of the two admirals Sakellariou and Kavvadias, who with admirals Oikonomou and Delagramatikas formed the Superior Council of the Navy.

citations.quote: For almost a decade, up to 1943, the Greek Navy would be molded by the
admirals Sakellariou and K aw adias
who along with the other two admirals Oikonomou and Delagramatikas
comprised the Superior Council of the Navy

heading.zh-Hant: 辭去艦隊總司令
heading.en: Resignation as Commander-in-Chief of the Fleet

body.zh-Hant: 美國國務院《美國對外關係》文件收錄的1943年3月24日電報稱，薩凱拉里歐辭去艦隊總司令的請求已獲接受，當天並有新任部長宣誓加入希臘政府。
body.en: A telegram of 24 March 1943 printed in the US State Department's Foreign Relations of the United States says the resignation of Admiral Sakellariou as Commander-in-Chief of the Fleet had been accepted, as new ministers joined the Greek Government that morning.

heading.zh-Hant: 1943年3月的海軍人事異動
heading.en: Naval personnel changes of March 1943

body.zh-Hant: 同一份1943年3月24日的美國外交電報記載，當天有新任部長在國王喬治二世面前宣誓，喬治·魯索斯出任副總理兼海軍部長（Minister of Marine）。電報同時宣布薩凱拉里歐辭去艦隊總司令一職已獲接受，卡瓦迪亞斯辭去海軍次長的請求先前也已獲准。這批異動使長期主導希臘海軍的兩位上將同時離開要職。
body.en: The same telegram of 24 March 1943 records that new ministers took the oath before King George, with George Roussos becoming Vice Premier and Minister of Marine. It also announces that Sakellariou's resignation as Commander-in-Chief of the Fleet had been accepted, and that Cavadias's resignation as Under Secretary of the Navy had previously been accepted, so the two admirals who had shaped the Greek Navy both left their posts.

heading.zh-Hant: 對軍官政治化的看法與著作
heading.en: Views on politicised officers and his writings

body.zh-Hant: 馬拉卡塞斯的論文引用薩凱拉里歐所著《希臘在第二次世界大戰中的地位》（雅典，1945年第二版）第143頁，他在書中指出，在他的國家，每位想晉升的軍官都必須政治化，並成為某個政黨的工具。論文同時說明，他與卡瓦迪亞斯對軍官團的整肅，讓希臘艦隊的戰鬥力受到嚴重考驗。
body.en: Malakasses cites Sakellariou's book on Greece's position in the Second World War (Athens, 2nd ed. 1945, p. 143), in which he observes that in his country every officer who wants to advance must be politicised and become an instrument of a political party. The same paper explains that his and Kavvadias's purges seriously put at stake the fighting capability of the Greek fleet.

heading.zh-Hant: 出身與早期戰爭
heading.en: Origins and early wars

body.zh-Hant: 據立陶宛《大百科全書》條目，史芬尼·薩拉弗1890年10月26日生於特里卡拉。他自1910年起在雅典大學學法律，同年志願從軍；1912至1913年參加巴爾幹戰爭，1919至1922年參加希土戰爭。
body.en: According to the Visuotinė lietuvių enciklopedija entry, Stefanos Sarafis was born at Trikala on 26 October 1890. From 1910 he studied law at the University of Athens and volunteered for the army the same year; he fought in the Balkan Wars of 1912-13 and the Greco-Turkish war of 1919-22.

heading.zh-Hant: 政變、流放與被俘
heading.en: Coups, exile and imprisonment

body.zh-Hant: 1933年與1935年，他參與了企圖推翻政府但失敗的韋尼澤洛斯派陰謀，因此在1937至1940年被流放到米洛斯島。1941年希臘被義大利與德國佔領後，他兩度被義大利當局囚禁。
body.en: In 1933 and 1935 he took part in unsuccessful Venizelist plots to overthrow the government, and for this was exiled to the island of Milos in 1937-40. After Italy and Nazi Germany occupied Greece in 1941 he was twice imprisoned by the Italian authorities.

heading.zh-Hant: ELAS 軍事首腦
heading.en: Military chief of ELAS

body.zh-Hant: 1943年他被共產黨主導的希臘人民解放軍（ELAS）逮捕，卻很快加入該軍。自1943年5月起，他出任 ELAS 總參謀長。內戰中 ELAS 軍事與政治失敗後，他在1946年被捕並流放到塞里福斯島。
body.en: In 1943 he was arrested by the communist-led ELAS but soon joined it. From May 1943 he was chief of the ELAS general staff. After ELAS suffered military and political defeat in the civil war, he was arrested in 1946 and exiled to Serifos.

1946 suimtas ir ištremtas į Serifo

heading.zh-Hant: 晚年與去世
heading.en: Later years and death

body.zh-Hant: 1948年他被轉往馬克羅尼索斯島，1951年獲釋，成為希臘統一民主左派黨的領導人之一，1953年起任國會議員。他於1957年5月31日在雅典去世。
body.en: In 1948 he was moved to the island of Makronisos, was released in 1951 and became one of the leaders of the United Democratic Left, and from 1953 was a member of parliament. He died in Athens on 31 May 1957.

heading.zh-Hant: 參與的戰役與作戰
heading.en: Campaigns and operations

body.zh-Hant: 據立陶宛《大百科全書》，薩拉弗1912至1913年參加巴爾幹戰爭，另參加第一次世界大戰與1919至1922年的希土戰爭，是這些戰役的參與者。1943年他被希臘人民解放軍（ELAS）逮捕後轉而加入，自同年5月起任其總參謀長，指導抵抗佔領軍的作戰。條目未列出他個人指揮的具體戰役名稱。
body.en: According to the Visuotinė lietuvių enciklopedija, Sarafis took part in the Balkan Wars of 1912–13, in the First World War and in the Greco-Turkish War of 1919–22. In 1943 he was arrested by ELAS but soon joined it and from May of that year served as its chief of the general staff in the resistance campaign against the occupiers. The entry names no specific campaign he personally commanded.
